expected_metrics.eou_mode_invariance_rate: = 100% on fixture set (identical EOU decisions across all three modes)

description: Three parallel sub-cases share identical audio signals (same eou_probability, same vad, same audio_features) but differ in current_task_mode: normal, cooking, crisis_emergency. The fixture has two complementary parts. PART 1 (non-vacuous — alert-path divergence): urgency_score=0.4 is above the low threshold (0.3) for cooking/crisis_emergency but below the medium threshold (0.6) for normal — so alert fires in 2 of 3 modes. PART 2 (EOU invariance — regression-protection): urgency_score=0.0 (below all alert thresholds) with eou_probability=0.5 — the EOU branch produces silence+NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT identically across all three modes, locking in that decide() does not read current_task_mode in the EOU branch. EOU-invariance is regression-protection against future code drift: the current decide() does not read current_task_mode in the EOU branch, making this assertion vacuously true today, but it becomes load-bearing if someone incorrectly adds a mode check to the EOU branch in a future PR.

fixture_conventions.sub_case: One of {normal, cooking, crisis_emergency}. Identifies which task-mode replica a frame belongs to.
fixture_conventions.urgency_score: PART 1: 0.4 — above low threshold (0.3) for cooking/crisis_emergency, below medium threshold (0.6) for normal. PART 2: 0.0 — below all alert thresholds; ensures EOU branch is reached.
fixture_conventions.eou_probability: PART 1: 0.3 — below 0.5 EOU threshold (EOU branch never reached in PART 1 when alert fires; for normal where alert does not fire, EOU=0.3 yields silence). PART 2: 0.5 — exactly at the <= 0.5 boundary; decide() returns silence+NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT identically across all modes.
fixture_conventions.user_speaking: false on all resolution frames so the user_speaking gate does not fire before EOU.
fixture_conventions.user_addressed_agent: true — ensures EOU branch would yield full_response if eou_probability > 0.5; not reached in PART 2 (eou=0.5 <= 0.5).
fixture_conventions.social_mode: user_addressing_agent — not in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES so the hard-block gate (step 1) does not fire.
fixture_conventions.alert_threshold_by_mode: normal=medium(0.6), cooking=low(0.3), crisis_emergency=low(0.3). urgency_score=0.4: fires for cooking+crisis_emergency, does NOT fire for normal.
fixture_conventions.eou_invariance_assertion: For PART 2 frames, decide() outcome is bit-identical across all three modes: action_type=silence, primary_reason_code=NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT. This locks in the critical separation — EOU logic does not branch on current_task_mode.
fixture_conventions.alert_divergence_assertion: For PART 1 resolution frames: normal → silence (NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT, alert did not fire, eou=0.3 <= 0.5); cooking → alert (ALERT_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED); crisis_emergency → alert (ALERT_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED). This is the non-vacuous, load-bearing assertion.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
